purpose: V-016 Room-moderation configs (prototype verification/prototypes/v016-room-moderation). mut_* disable one rule; residual_* document an accepted risk; trap_* are golden witnesses.

models.claim: every applied action authorised against the state it is ordered after; bans exclude; governance protected
moderation authority is always room-scoped; Space moderation only through the Room's binding
no message from an excluded member is accepted at or after the excluding epoch; removal is a rekey; old-epoch acceptance bounded by the window
evidence readable only by moderators in force at report time; never marked verifiable; retention bounded
mutation: authorise at signing time, so a demoted moderator's in-flight ban still applies
mutation: an admission signed before a ban readmits the banned principal
mutation: moderators of any room / unbound Space act everywhere
mutation: an ordinary moderator removes a governance principal
mutation: removal without an epoch advance leaves the removed member holding the live key
mutation: evidence encrypted to a stale moderator list reaches a demoted moderator
residual: past-epoch window makes acceptance of late messages receiver-dependent
golden: a demoted moderator's in-flight ban is rejected
golden: ban then unban both apply in commit order
golden: admission racing a ban is rejected
golden: a removed member's old-epoch message is still accepted inside the window
golden: appeal extends evidence retention to RetainMax+HoldMax
